title: Interactive numerical methods gallery
objective: Implement the P7 gallery infrastructure and complete root-finding teaching story from structured evidence, with extensible manifests for later domain stories

oracles: Structured NumericalResult and trace fixtures; browser PlotSpec rendering tests

handoff.summary: Implemented the P7 dependency-free numerical teaching gallery and its extensible manifest/story schemas. The generated root-finding story is derived from current NumericalResult, NumericalTrace, and PlotAnimation objects and contrasts a validated Brent solve (independently checked by bisection) with discontinuity, invalid-bracket, and Newton-cycle failures. The browser selects explanations and actions only from cited structured fields, renders the semantic PlotSpec with manual/reduced-motion-safe controls, preserves a complete static SVG/trace/failure/language lesson, and exports the original PlotSpec/PlotAnimation JSON, portable Plotly JSON, and script-free accessible HTML. Fail-closed budgets cover story size, all five result/verification trace event and byte counts, animation frames, samples, and semantic/Plotly payloads, including stale-measurement detection. The fresh focused receipt passes all 9 tests, including live Chromium interaction, reduced motion, mobile overflow, and no-script behavior; merge invariants also pass.
risks: `pnpm docs:check` is recorded as a baseline failure after its full seven-stage build passed: untouched shared `docs/reference/api.md`, `website/reference-data.json`, or the fingerprinted `website/reference.html` is stale. These outputs are outside this task's claims and the gallery paths do not feed `scripts/generate-docs.cjs`.

`pnpm test:tutorial` is a baseline failure on the untouched numerical foundation: Sage Guided Tour reports 325 passed and 337 failed across 662 selected examples. Repairing shared tutorial/runtime compatibility is outside this gallery task's claims.

The base-relative `pnpm test:changed` plan selects merge checks, unit tests, and docs checks. Merge checks pass, but `pnpm test:unit` stops after 8 of 115 files because three inherited `test/gf2-polynomial-packed-core.cjs` native compilation cases cannot find `flint/nmod_mat.h`; 2 cases in that file pass and 3 fail. The shared docs check then remains blocked as above.

The current shared `sagejs.plotting.lower_plot_animation` rejects the numerical PlotAnimation axis representation. The story records that blocked lowering honestly and uses a deterministic checked Plotly adapter until the shared graphics/numerics boundary is reconciled.
Live browser validation was run on linux-x64; required linux-arm64 and macos-arm64 coverage remains for central CI/qualification.
next_steps: In the integration lane, refresh or repair the shared generated reference documentation and tutorial baseline, provision the FLINT native headers/cache for unit validation, then rerun the declared shared checks and move this task to review.
Link `/numerical-computing/` from shared website navigation or routing in an integration-owned change.

Reconcile numerical PlotSpec axis fields with the shared Plotly lowering contract, regenerate `root-finding.json`, and change the checked shared-lowering record from blocked only when that real lowering succeeds.
Run the focused browser suite on the required linux-arm64 and macos-arm64 hosts.
